subject: english
title: REVIEW MIDTERM 1 (PART 1) - TỔNG ÔN GIỮA KÌ 1
subTitle: Our Community, Adverbs of Frequency, Verb Patterns (like -ing vs want to)

cards.vietnamese: Người coi sóc trường học (bảo vệ/lao công) & Nữ hiệu trưởng
cards.definition: Caretaker looks after a building. Headmistress is a female school principal.
cards.example: Our caretaker opens the gate. The headmistress speaks in assembly.

cards.vietnamese: Rất yêu thích / đam mê (đi với V-ing)
cards.definition: Keen on + V-ing / Be into + V-ing means to like an activity very much.
cards.example: My brother is keen on playing chess. I am into swimming.

cards.vietnamese: Like/love/enjoy + V-ing (sở thích) | Want/hope/plan + to-V (dự định, mong muốn)
cards.definition: Verbs of like/dislike take -ing. Verbs of intention/hope take to-infinitive.
cards.example: Evie enjoys playing tennis. We want to go to the cinema tonight.

cards.vietnamese: Đứng TRƯỚC động từ thường, đứng SAU động từ To Be
cards.definition: Always, usually, often, sometimes, hardly ever, never.
cards.example: He ALWAYS rides his bike. She is NEVER late for school.

exercises.question: My younger brother hopes ________ the school football championship this year.
exercises.explanation: Động từ 'hope' đi với to-infinitive (hopes to win).

exercises.question: Sarah is very keen on ________ piano melodies in the evening.
exercises.explanation: Cụm 'keen on' (thích thú) đi với V-ing (playing).

exercises.question: Choose the sentence with the CORRECT word order:
options: Our teacher rides always his bicycle to school.
Our teacher always rides his bicycle to school.
Our teacher rides his bicycle always to school.
Always our teacher rides his bicycle to school.
exercises.explanation: Trạng từ chỉ tần suất 'always' đứng ngay trước động từ thường 'rides'.

exercises.question: The person who cleans and takes care of the school grounds is the ________.
exercises.explanation: Người bảo vệ, coi sóc khuôn viên trường học là caretaker.
